unchanged: every v3 estimator, constant, cohort rule, cost (10 bp), matched containment baseline, lean-drift computation, paired statistic, weekly resampling and claim threshold; the frozen desk_calls.py and test_desk_calls.py bytes

admission_bases.quote: the read quoted its registry id and receipt (the v3 rule)
admission_bases.order-record: the read did not quote its receipt, but a delivery record shows delivery at or after the receipt: read.order_record = {source: conversation-record | operator, delivered_utc, available_utc, ref}; the record must have been AVAILABLE (available_utc) by the evaluation's cutoff; a missing available_utc leaves the call order-unverified

call_types.conditional: registered when stated (id letter K): direction; trigger {1h|4h closes, above|below, level, first and last trigger close}; graded close; invalidation line on 1H closes. Converts at the first trigger close; graded from market data; scored as its own call type, never pooled

changed_population.withdrawal: a registered withdrawal (id letter W) with its own receipt and read-back, registered after the call and available at the evaluation cutoff; effective only if its receipt precedes the first possible trigger close, or every trigger close up to its receipt is present and none triggered; a trigger close at or before the receipt voids it; missing history leaves the call unavailable
changed_population.expiry: a conditional with no trigger close in its window is recorded expired, never scored
changed_population.evidence_availability: every evidence object (receipt, read-back, withdrawal, order record, market data) must have been available at the evaluation cutoff (inclusive); later evidence supports only a newly dated reassessment

outcomes.conditional_grade: invalidation-path plain grade: right if the graded close is beyond the trigger close in the call's direction and no 1H close between them crossed the invalidation line
outcomes.unit_d: terminal-close directional log return minus the registered lean drift - not the P&L of a strategy that exits at invalidation
outcomes.signal_benchmark: the frozen trigger-close signal benchmark is retained with its limitations; an executable benchmark (first eligible tradable quote after observation, processing and durable activation) would be a separately versioned policy - none is registered here

baselines.lean and conditional: v3 lean drift from the trigger close (primary); no registered standard error

deduplication: the v3 rule (first receipt per instrument, type, horizon and graded close; ties by call id, reported), applied separately within each population
sensitivity: populations all-admitted, quote-only and order-record-only, each a complete recomputation of eligibility, de-duplication and scoring (desk_register.score_v31); the conditional funnel (registered, not-admitted, invalid, late, pending, expired, withdrawn, unavailable, scored) is reported beside any conditional score

evidence_classes.original-rule: admitted on a quoted receipt, as v3 required (a correction under the original rule needs evidence that the quoted receipt really existed)
evidence_classes.retrospective-reassessment: newly eligible under the order-record rule, registered before the v3.1 effective time
evidence_classes.prospective-v3.1: registered at or after the v3.1 effective time

effective_time: the first push of this directory to main (merge commit time, GitHub activity API). The 12.4.19 package implemented these rules on Oct 19 2026 without a published, verifiable record; that earlier timing cannot be established, so no call registered before the effective time is prospective v3.1 evidence. Nothing is backdated.
private_records: call documents, receipts, reads and order records are private desk records; this public specification identifies the policy by hashes only
corrections: the 12.4.19 changelog's claim that a 3-3 split of plain grades showed the amendment could not have been chosen for its effect is withdrawn: equal win/loss counts do not establish outcome independence. The amendment's basis is the operator decision of Oct 19 2026 that the rule applies to every order-unverified call whatever its outcome; its effect is reported by the population sensitivity, not argued.
